news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹4.42 loss per share (vs ₹4.85 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹4.42 loss per share (improved from ₹4.85 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹183.1m (up ₹161.1m from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹20.8m (loss narrowed 8.9% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 34% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
